name: sm2_sequences
held_out: Grade sequences enumerated from the branch structure of the published SM-2 algorithm (first review, second review, the n>2 recurrence, the q<3 relearning branch, the 1.3 E-factor floor) rather than from olivia/study/srs.py. Disjoint from tests/test_study/test_study.py, which exercises single reviews; these are multi-step trajectories.
scoring: Every state after every grade is compared field by field against olivia.eval.sm2_reference. A sequence counts as exact only if ease, interval, and repetition count all match at every step.
